Direction (Jack Heart, 2026-11-12): "or latest of antoher arm" (arm = job). Add a relative seat for another job's latest checkpoint, e.g. `Latest(job="w64", inference=...)`, beside `Aligned`. "Latest" is resolved when the seating is held for a checkpoint and recorded with it, so a played match never moves as the other job saves more; a later hold may resolve to a newer one. With the subject at its own final checkpoint this gives final vs final.
